अन्दू f. (-न्दूः)
 1. An ornament worn round the ancles.
 2. The chain for
an elephant's feet.
 3. A chain, a fetter, a bond or tie.
 E. अदि
to bind, and कू Unādi aff. or with कु affix अन्दु.

अन्दुक m. (-कः)
 1. A ring or chain worn on the ancle.
 2. The chain for
an elephant's feet.
 E. अदि to bind, कु affix, and कन् final.
अन्दूक m. (-कः) The chain for an elephant's feet. See the last.
अन्दोल (-त) r. 10th cl. (अन्दोलयति) To agitate, to swing.
आन्दोल r. 10th cl. (-त) आन्दोलयति To swing.

आन्दोल m. (-लः) Swinging.
 E. आन्दोल to swing and घञ् aff.

. A swing.
 3. Trembling, oscillation. E.
आन्दोल to swing, ल्युट् aff.
आन्दोलित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Swung, shaken. E. Participle past of आन्दोल.
